assessment.rationale: New Hampshire ratified the congressional pay amendment on March 7, 1985, while the original Bill of Rights (first through twelfth proposed amendments) were ratified by eleven states by December 15, 1791, when Virginia ratified them.
assessment.synthesis_coverage: The congressional pay amendment ratified in 1992 spanned over 200 years from its 1789 proposal, while the original Bill of Rights amendments were ratified within approximately two years (1789-1791).
assessment.provenance_note: Spans show ratification timing of congressional pay amendment versus Bill of Rights. Congressional pay amendment took over 200 years from proposal to final ratification in 1992. Bill of Rights were ratified by 1791.
limitations: Comparison requires counting all original Bill of Rights ratifications vs. the single pay amendment; some Bill of Rights amendments ratified later by individual states (Massachusetts, Georgia, Connecticut in 1939) but core Bill of Rights completed by 1791.
